body.message:
Hi Mohammad,

Thank you for your message and for your interest in referring potential tenants to us.

At the moment, we do not offer referral fees or commission arrangements for external agents or referrals.

However, we can share our rental rates with you, and you are welcome to add your own commission on top of our quoted rate when presenting the property to prospective tenants.

Thank you once again, and we appreciate your support.
